Meta.title: Aydın Campus Map
Meta.description: Find the shortest walking route on the Florya campus in 3D and preview it in 360°.

Brand.name: Aydın Campus Map
Brand.independent: An independent project, not an official university app.

Route.title: Route
Route.empty: Pick a start and a destination to draw the shortest walking route.
Route.noRoute: There is no walkable route between these places yet. Try a nearby entrance.
Route.apiDown: The route service is not reachable. Try again in a few seconds.
Route.coverage: Routes cover the campus grounds and building entrances. Building interiors follow as the virtual tour is processed.
Route.pickStartHint: Pick a place or type one above.
Route.linkCopied: Route link copied to the clipboard.
Route.linkCopyFailed: The link could not be copied. You can share the address bar link instead.

Environment.source: Source: Open-Meteo. Times in campus time (UTC+3).

Attribution.imagery: 360° imagery: İstanbul Aydın University virtual tour

Chat.title: Campus assistant
Chat.intro: Ask about a place on campus, a floor, or how to walk there. Route answers are drawn on the map.
Chat.suggest1: How do I get to the A Block entrance?
Chat.suggest2: How many floors does the library have, and what is inside?
Chat.suggest3: What can I see at the campus entrance?
Chat.error: The assistant is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
Chat.rateLimited: Too many questions at once; wait a few seconds and try again.
Chat.notice: Answers come from free AI services (Groq, Google Gemini); providers may use questions to improve their services. Do not share personal information.

Landing.title: Wherever you're headed on campus, here is the shortest way.
Landing.stage0Body: A 3D map of İstanbul Aydın University's Florya campus, with walking routes built from its 360° virtual tour, step by step.
Landing.stage1: From the Bosphorus to the Marmara shore
Landing.stage1Body: From where two continents meet, we descend west towards Küçükçekmece.
Landing.stage2: Florya, beside the former Atatürk Airport
Landing.stage2Body: The campus sits on the airport's western edge, in Beşyol, a few kilometres north of the Marmara.
Landing.stage3Body: Pick where you are and where you're going: the route is drawn on the 3D map, and every step can be previewed in 360°.
